 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organization Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day\-to\-day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for development and support of Web based digital applications and delivering high\-quality solutions. The ideal candidate would be part of a major technology transformation team responsible for moving towards cloud platform using Java, Spring boot and Node.js, and will leverage working knowledge of platforms such as PCF and AWS. * Solid experience with modern architecture patterns (REST APIs, event\-driven systems), and building mission\-critical services with high availability and performance.
* Experience with Micro\-Frontends (preferred) and front\-end architecture, including shared components, governance, and build/deploy strategies.
* Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud\-native practices (preferred), including security, scalability, and cost\-aware design.
* Familiarity with Apigee or a similar API management platform is preferred but not required.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automation, and DevOps practices; ability to influence release strategy and improve engineering productivity.
* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL data stores, data modeling, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release management, and change/incident management; comfortable leading technical ceremonies (grooming, design reviews, retros).
* AI\-assisted development experience: practical use of tools such as GitHub Copilot/ChatGPT/enterprise LLMs to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and code reviews—while ensuring secure usage, code quality, and compliance.
* Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts/on\-call as needed to support production issues and critical releases.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**

description:
**Gurugram, hybrid · Full\-time · 3–5 years · Start 1 October 2026 · Immediate joiners preferred** 




  





**﻿
 
 About RAYY** 




 RAYY is a booking marketplace for sports academies, fitness classes and kids' learning
 



 activities, live in Gurugram and expanding to a second city. We are a small, fast\-moving team
 



 raising our first institutional round, and we are bringing engineering in\-house now.
 



**The role** 




 You will be one of the first two engineers at RAYY, working directly with the CPTO. The product
 



 is a Flutter customer app, a FastAPI backend on MongoDB, and Next.js dashboards for partners
 



 and our own team, on AWS. You will work end to end across all of it rather than in one layer.
 



 There is a full roadmap of customer\-facing features shipping this quarter, a backlog to clear,
 



 and releases to take over from our vendor; you will be building from day one and helping set
 



 how we build as the team grows.
 



**What you'll do** 




 Own features from API to screen across Flutter, Python and TypeScript. Fix, refactor and extend
 



 code you did not write. Ship to the Play Store and App Store and keep production healthy. Use
 



 AI coding tools as a normal part of your work, and review what they produce with the same
 



 care as your own. Write tests where they matter, especially anywhere money moves.
 



**What we're looking for** 




 Three to five years at a product company, with at least one consumer app shipped to real
 



 users; payments or marketplace experience is a plus. Working ability in at least two of Flutter,
 



 Python and TypeScript, and the willingness to work in all three. Familiarity with MongoDB, a
 



 payment gateway such as Razorpay, and AWS basics. Comfort with small teams and
 



 ambiguity: you would rather ship and learn than wait for a spec. Clear communication, since
 



 you will talk to partners and the CEO, not only to engineers. Available to start on or around 1
 



 October.
 



**Nice to have** 




 Experience at a food, fitness or booking marketplace. Prior work taking over a codebase from
 



 an agency or vendor. Flutter release tooling or Next.js.
 



**How we work** 




 Five\-day week, hybrid from our Gurugram office, with flexibility around business needs during
 



 launches and our fundraise. Small PRs, fast reviews, outcomes over hours. You will be judged
 



 on what ships and whether it stays up.
 



**Compensation** 




 Fixed salary, competitive for stage and experience.
 



**Process** 




 A short call with the CPTO, a two\-hour take\-home on our stack (use whatever tools you like; we
 



 discuss the diff together), and a conversation with the CEO. The whole loop fits in five days,
 



 and we can start you within a week of offer.
 



**To apply** 




 Send a CV or LinkedIn profile and a link to something you've shipped to hr@rayy.io with
 



 "Product Engineer" in the subject line.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.
2. A short answer: You have one week and no data science team. How would you decide which worker to send to a booking? A paragraph is plenty. We care about how you think, not the right answer.
3. Anything you've built that people outside your company actually used.



 We move fast: intro call, a paid take\-home or a day working with us on a real problem, founder conversation, offer. Typically under two weeks.

 We care more about what you have tried to build than how many certificates you have collected.

 • A website or web application

 • A Python application

 • An API integration
 



 • An automation workflow
 



 • A dashboard
 



 • A cloud project
 



 • A GitHub repository

 • What did you build?
 



 • What part did you personally work on?
 



 • What problems did you face?
 



 • How did you solve them?
 



 • What did you learn?

 Learning Ability
 



 Can you understand something unfamiliar and start working with it?
 



  





 Problem Solving
 



 Can you break an unfamiliar problem into smaller pieces and work towards a solution?
 



  





 Curiosity
 



 Do you explore technology beyond your college curriculum?

 Can you take responsibility for completing something?

 Do you actually build things rather than only completing courses and certifications?

 Can you clearly explain what you have built and how it works?

 • Full Stack / MERN
 



 • Python / Backend Engineering
 



 • Cloud \& DevOps

 We want to identify people with strong fundamentals and learning ability and then align them with the technology track where they can perform best.

 • Explain something they have built

 • Solve a basic programming or logical problem
 



 • Work through a real\-world technology use case
 



 • Explore an unfamiliar technology and explain their approach
 



 • Complete a short practical assignment

title: Principal / Senior Software Engineer - Mobile Monetization (Ad Server)
description:
**About The Role**
 PubMatic is seeking an experienced and technically strong Principal Software Engineer to lead the design and development of next\-generation Mobile App Monetization capabilities. This role is focused on building high\-performance, low\-latency, scalable, and privacy\-safe systems that help maximize publisher revenue from in\-app inventory while improving DSP and buyer spend efficiency.
   

  

 The role requires a deep understanding of mobile app advertising, SSP\-DSP RTB workflows, OpenRTB mobile signals, SDK/mediation integrations, traffic shaping, QPS optimization, mobile attribution, privacy constraints, and performance advertising. The engineer will work on systems that monetize mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video ads.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a seasoned backend engineer with strong ad\-tech domain expertise and experience building real\-time auction, targeting, decisioning, and optimization systems. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketplace Quality, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, and SRE to build ML\-integrated and data\-driven monetization systems that improve yield, bid rate, win rate, fill rate, attribution readiness, latency, and reliability across PubMatic’s mobile app ecosystem.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Architect and implement scalable backend services powering mobile app monetization, extracting, transforming, and optimizing in\-app behavioral data using on\-device computation, data aggregation, and differential privacy techniques so that publishers can still deliver targeted ads and measure performance without accessing persistent, individual user identities.
* Build and optimize SSP\-DSP integration workflows for mobile app inventory, including app bundle validation, device and geo signal handling, privacy\-aware user signal processing, bid response handling, loss reason analysis, and DSP\-specific troubleshooting.
* Design mobile\-specific traffic shaping and QPS optimization systems that prioritize high\-value in\-app inventory based on bid probability, win probability, spend potential, app quality, device signals, geo value, ad format, consent availability, and DSP buying behavior.
* Improve runtime handling for Mobile App ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and in\-app video, including format eligibility, creative compatibility, response validation, tracking, completion, and reward\-callback correctness.
* Build capabilities that improve buyer/DSP compatibility for MApp inventory, ensuring buyers receive well\-represented, privacy\-compliant, format\-compatible, attribution\-ready, and supply\-quality\-aware mobile app requests.
* Develop systems and diagnostics to improve Mobile App supply quality, including app bundle validation, app store metadata checks, app\-ads.txt, sellers.json, SupplyChain object validation, app spoofing detection, invalid traffic indicators, device/geo inconsistency checks, and low\-quality partner supply detection.
* Support privacy\-aware and attribution\-ready Mobile App advertising, including ATT/IDFA handling, AAID availability, consent enforcement, COPPA/child\-directed treatment, SKAN readiness, MMP signal passing, click/impression tracking, and privacy\-safe fallback when user\-level identifiers are unavailable.
* Partner with MApp SDK and OpenBid/S2S integration teams to define signal\-quality standards, request\-field expectations, placement/ad\-unit semantics, tracking requirements, and partner feedback loops for Mobile App supply.
* Build publisher\-facing and buyer\-facing diagnostics for MApp inventory, including missing\-field reports, app quality signals, buyer no\-bid diagnostics, fill and eCPM diagnostics, tracking mismatch analysis, attribution readiness, and supply\-path quality insights.
* Work with DSP Partnerships and Marketplace Quality teams to improve buyer confidence in PubMatic’s MApp supply by addressing format compatibility, attribution readiness, privacy eligibility, fraud risk, supply transparency, and app inventory quality.
* Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Publisher teams, DSP Partnerships, Marketplace Quality, MApp SDK, OpenBid/S2S integrations, and SRE to define and execute the roadmap for differentiated Mobile App advertising capabilities.
* Champion operational excellence for Mobile App advertising systems through strong observability, reason codes, structured logs, dashboards, alerts, safe rollouts, latency protection, production debugging, and cross\-team incident response.


**We'd Love for You to Have**
* Five plus years of backend engineering experience, with a proven track record of building high\-scale, low\-latency systems, preferably in mobile app advertising, SSP, DSP, ad exchange, mediation, mobile SDK, app\-install, or programmatic AdTech domains.
* Strong knowledge of mobile app inventory signals, including app bundle, app store URL, SDK version, placement type, rewarded indicator, device ID, IDFA, AAID, IDFV, OS version, carrier, connection type, geo, consent status, and ad format metadata.
* Familiarity with mobile ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and in\-app video ads, including how each format impacts pricing, buyer demand, creative rendering, tracking, and user experience.
* Strong understanding of mobile performance advertising concepts such as app\-install campaigns, CPI, CPA, ROAS, retention, lifetime value, post\-install events, retargeting where allowed, and buyer outcome optimization.
* Experience or strong familiarity with mobile attribution and measurement ecosystems, including MMPs, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, Firebase, SKAdNetwork, Android attribution changes, click tracking, impression tracking, and delayed/aggregated conversion signals.
* Strong knowledge of mobile privacy and compliance constraints, including Apple ATT, IDFA availability, Android Advertising ID, SKAdNetwork, Google Privacy Sandbox for Android, COPPA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, TCF, GPP, and do\-not\-sell/share flags.
* Practical knowledge of mobile supply quality and fraud prevention, including app bundle spoofing, SDK spoofing, device spoofing, geo mismatch, VPN/proxy traffic, click injection, click spam, invalid traffic, app\-ads.txt, sellers.json, and SupplyChain object validation.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset, strong ownership, and ability to work cross\-functionally with Product, Data Science, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, Marketplace Quality, and SRE.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with mobile monetization SDKs, client\-server ad request flows, mediation logic, in\-app bidding, server\-side bidding, waterfalls, or unified auction systems.
* Contributions to open\-source AdTech projects such as Prebid Mobile, RTBkit, OpenRTB tools, header bidding libraries, or mobile SDK/ad\-serving frameworks.
* Familiarity with industry\-standard ML model\-serving infrastructure designed for real\-time inference in high\-QPS, low\-latency environments.
* Understanding of mobile user acquisition, performance DSPs, app\-install campaigns, MMP integrations, and attribution platforms.
* Experience working with incrementality measurement, retargeting systems, audience segmentation, cohort\-based optimization, or privacy\-safe targeting for mobile performance marketing.
* Exposure to privacy\-preserving user ID solutions such as UID2\.0, RampID, publisher first\-party IDs, hashed identifiers where allowed, and frameworks such as SKAdNetwork for iOS post\-ATT monetization.
* Experience with cross\-format mobile monetization strategies, including combining rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video monetization within the same app session.
* Familiarity with real\-time analytics pipelines used to measure mobile monetization KPIs such as bid rate, win rate, fill rate, eCPM, revenue, QPS efficiency, timeout rate, attribution feedback, buyer spend, and yield efficiency.
* Publications, patents, internal platform leadership, or speaking engagements in mobile monetization, AdTech infrastructure, RTB optimization, privacy\-safe advertising, or ML for AdTech.


**Why Join Us?**
* Work on high\-scale mobile monetization infrastructure that directly impacts publisher revenue, DSP spend, and advertiser outcomes across the in\-app advertising ecosystem.
* Help shape the future of ML\-powered mobile monetization, real\-time ad decisioning, traffic shaping, attribution readiness, and privacy\-safe performance advertising.

* Collaborate with industry\-leading engineers, product teams, machine learning experts, DSP partners, publisher teams, and marketplace quality teams.

Engineers who demonstrate AI\-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high\-scale, performance\-critical environment.

As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.

**Mobile App Developer** 




  





**Location: New Delhi (Work from Office)**

**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




  





**Who We Are:** 




 PanScience Innovations is India's largest deep\-tech and AI venture studio. Rather than investing in companies from the outside, we co\-found them: we originate the idea, embed a team from day one, and build out the product, technology, go\-to\-market, operations, finance, and legal functions alongside each venture's core team. We've co\-founded 24\+ ventures across healthcare, finance, judiciary, media, and industrial AI, and our role is to take deep science that would otherwise stay in a lab and turn it into a company that can stand on its own.
 



  





**Who you'll Work with:** 




 You'll be looped into multiple portfolio ventures rather than sitting inside just one, working closely with each venture's product and engineering leads and PanScience's central studio functions. You won't be one mobile developer among many on a large team; you'll often own the mobile experience end to end for a venture, and you'll draw on the studio's shared design, backend, and QA resources when you need them.
 



  





**What you'll Do:** 



* Design and build production\-grade cross\-platform apps in Flutter, taking a feature from a wireframe or a rough idea through to something real users rely on daily.
* Own the app end to end: architecture, state management, navigation, offline behaviour, and performance, not just the screens that are easiest to build.
* Integrate with REST/GraphQL APIs and backend services, and work directly with backend engineers to shape contracts rather than just consuming whatever is handed to you.
* Write code that another engineer can pick up without you in the room: clean architecture, sensible state management (Bloc, Riverpod, or Provider), and tests that actually catch regressions.
* Ship to the Play Store and App Store yourself, including release builds, versioning, crash monitoring, and the small platform\-specific details that separate a working app from a polished one.
* Chase down performance issues and jank instead of accepting them as normal, whether that's a slow list, a memory leak, or a startup time that's crept up over releases.
* Push back on scope and native\-plugin shortcuts that will cost the team later; protecting app stability and maintainability is part of the job, not a side effect of it.



  





**What you should Bring:** 



* 3\-5 years of mobile development experience, with at least 1\-2 years building and shipping production Flutter apps that are live on the Play Store and/or App Store today.
* Minimum Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Strong command of Dart and Flutter fundamentals: widget lifecycle, state management, custom animations, and platform channels for native integrations.
* Working knowledge of native Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift) development, enough to debug platform\-specific issues Flutter can't fully abstract away.
* Comfort with the full app lifecycle: CI/CD for mobile, app store submissions, crash reporting (Firebase Crashlytics or similar), and analytics instrumentation.
* Solid grasp of REST/GraphQL integration, local storage (SQLite/Hive/Isar), and secure handling of auth tokens and sensitive user data.
* Comfort moving with limited structure, and a willingness to set up the tooling, conventions, and CI pipeline yourself rather than waiting for someone to hand it to you.



  





**Good to Have:** 



* Experience integrating on\-device ML (TensorFlow Lite, ML Kit) or real\-time features (sockets, push notifications, background sync).
* Exposure to native module development in Kotlin/Swift, or prior experience with React Native, for comparison and migration decisions.



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




 Within your first few months, you should have shipped at least one release to production that meaningfully improved a real metric — crash\-free rate, load time, retention, or a feature adoption number — and be able to explain plainly what changed and why. Longer term, success means the venture's mobile app is something the team trusts you to own: fewer surprises in production, and a codebase the next engineer can actually build on.
